item.title: Two Years, A Seed
item.description:
Two years….

Two years working at the SPIT Alumni Network.

Long, long, long, long, long time.

Long enough to move across floors. Long enough to stay in rooms. Long enough to come early in the morning and stay late into the night. Long enough to see the sunrise and the sunset from the same place.

I have been around.

I won’t say I have explored everything. I haven’t.

But I have seen a range of things happen.

item.title: From Victim Mindset to Victory
item.description:
Once you move out of a victim mindset, you begin to see the victory.

You can only control what is within your control.

A little selfishness is sometimes necessary if it helps you become a better version of yourself.

Constantly trying to help everyone else can slowly push you into the backseat of your own life.

You have to help yourself first. Focus on what you can control for yourself.
